data.name: Asbaat
data.gender_notes: Asbaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Asbaat is an Arabic name for young sheep. It is derived from the Arabic word ‘asbaah’ which means young sheep. It is a beautiful and unique name that carries a sense of freshness and innocence. The name Asbaat carries the meaning “Young Sheep” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Asbaat usually hope their child will grow to embody young sheep and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Asbaat is a name that signifies new beginnings, growth, and innocence. It is a name that is full of hope and promise, and is a reminder of the beauty and wonder of creation.
data.etymology: Asbaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Young Sheep.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asbaat total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: أسبات
in_arabic.meaning: أسبات يعني الثبات و الاستقرار و القوة في العقيدة
in_arabic.long_meaning: أسبات هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'س-ب-ت' والذي يعني الثبات و الاستقرار. و هو يدل على القوة في العقيدة و الصبر على الشدائد. و قد ورد هذا المعنى في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'و استثبتوا في الأرض' (الحج: 31). و يعتبر اسم أسبات من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني عميقة و قوية في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: اسباط
in_urdu.meaning: اسباط کا مطلب ہے ثبات، استحکام اور ایمان کی طاقت
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسباط ایک عربی نام ہے جو جڑ 'س-ب-ت' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے ثبات، استحکام اور ایمان کی طاقت۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ صبر و استقامت اور ایمان کی مضبوطی کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔ قرآن مجید میں بھی اس جڑ کے متعلق آیات ہیں، جیسے کہ 'و استثبتوا في الأرض' (الحج: 31) جو زمین پر ثابت قدمی کی تاکید کرتی ہیں۔ اس نام کا استعمال جنوب ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں عام ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अस्बात
in_hindi.meaning: अस्बात का अर्थ है स्थिरता, दृढ़ता और आस्था की शक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: अस्बात एक अरबी नाम है जो 'स-ब-त' मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है स्थिरता, दृढ़ता और आस्था की शक्ति। इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा में है क्योंकि यह धैर्य, स्थिरता और मजबूत आध्यात्मिकता की ओर संकेत करता है। कुरआन में भी इस जड़ से संबंधित उल्लेख हैं, जैसे कि 'व इस्तथबतु फी अल-अरद' (अल-हज्ज: 31), जो पृथ्वी पर दृढ़ता की बात कहता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी प्रचलित है।

in_pashto.name: اسباټ
in_pashto.meaning: اسباټ د ثبات، ټينګښې او د ايمان قوت مانا لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: اسباټ د عربي نوم څخه اخيستل شوی دی، د 'س-ب-ت' ريښې څخه چې د ثبات، ټينګښې او د ايمان قوت مانا لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتن مسلمانو په ميراث کې يو مهم ځای لري، ځکه چې دا د صبر، استقامت او د روحاني قوت نښه ده. په قرآن کريم کې د دې ريښې اړوند عبارتونه دي، لکه 'و استثبتوا في الأرض' (الحج: 31) چې د ځمکې پر ثبات ټينګار کوي.

in_english.name: Asbaat
in_english.meaning: Asbaat means stability, strength, and power of faith
in_english.long_meaning: Asbaat is an Arabic name derived from the root 's-b-t', signifying stability, strength, and power of faith. It holds significant importance in Islamic tradition as it denotes patience, perseverance, and spiritual resilience. References to this root can be found in the Quran, such as 'و استثبتوا في الأرض' (الحج: 31), emphasizing the importance of steadfastness on earth. The name Asbaat is used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing positive attributes and character traits.

data.cultural_impact: The name Asbaat holds a significant cultural impact in Islamic traditions, as the sacrifice of a young sheep is an essential part of the annual Hajj pilgrimage. During this pilgrimage, millions of Muslims from around the world gather in Mecca to perform various rituals in commemoration of the Prophet Ibrahim's obedience to God. One of these rituals is the symbolic act of sacrificing an animal, such as a sheep, to remember Ibrahim's willingness to sacrifice his beloved son Ismail at God's command. Although not all Muslims perform the sacrifice themselves, the act holds cultural significance and is remembered as a powerful reminder of faith, sacrifice, and devotion.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Asbaat signifies purity, innocence, and obedience to God. Just as a young sheep is pure and obedient to its flock and shepherd, the name encourages individuals to embody these same qualities in their own lives. The name also holds symbolic significance in the Islamic tradition of sharing the blessings of the sacrifice with others less fortunate. By following this practice, individuals can strengthen their spiritual connection with God and serve as a beacon of compassion and generosity to others. Additionally, the sacrifice itself is an act of devotion and obedience to God, reinforcing the importance of submission and obedience to the divine will.
